Alex D: Quick one — I need to swap my Sat oncall (09:00–17:00 UTC). Travel came up. This includes covering a Redwood Private customer KMS audit at ~10:45 UTC and a small canary rollout around 11:30 that may jitter latency. Looking for two people to split 09–13 / 13–17.
Maria T: I can do 09:00–13:00 UTC. Will join the audit call. @Alex D which KMS key/credentials should I check?
Jon P: I can cover 13:00–17:00 UTC. Need the handoff notes and any gating checks for the canary.
Alex D: KMS key id: abcdef-1234 (partial). Run `redwood-kms-cli status --key abcdef-1234` and verify "KeyState: Enabled" + last-rotation < 90d. Audit runbook: https://go/runbooks/kms-audit (contains phone bridge + checklist).
Maria T: Copy. I'll shadow the canary @ 11:30 and watch service_fallback_rate and auth_error_rate. If auth_error_rate > 1% for 5m, start rollback sequence (see step 6 in the runbook). Rollback quick command in runbook: `curl -XPOST https://console.redwood/infrastructure/rollout/rollback -d '{"canary":true}'`
Oncall Bot: Reminder — use `/oncall swap` to update the rota and record the handoff. Failure to update rota will auto-escalate.
DevOps SRE: Heads up — during KMS verification we might see transient 401s for ~2–5m if a key is being validated by the HSM. We've added a routing fallback but monitor traffic spikes. If you hit sustained 401s > 10m open a Sev-2 and tag #eng-oncall + me.
Jon P: Thanks — I've added myself to the rota for 13:00–17:00 UTC using `/oncall swap` and set a calendar block. Alex, please confirm any vault access is listed in the runbook.
Alex D: Confirmed — I left the vault entry (team-vault/redwood/private/keys/abcdef-1234) with 2FA requirement noted. Also note KV cache snapshot at timestamp 2026-03-20T08:00Z. If you see tail latencies > 200ms after canary, warm the KV by hitting `/internal/warmup` with 8 concurrent requests or use the curl helper in the runbook.
Maria T: Acknowledged. I'll monitor tail-latency, auth errors, and cost metrics during my shift. Will update here after the audit. :thumbsup:
Jon P: Got it. I'll take over the post-audit watch and keep an eye on any residual auth spikes. Ping me in thread if the audit flags anything.
Alex D: Thanks both. Handing off now — leaving the runbook link and a short sticky in the rota. Appreciate the split cover. :pray:
